autoscaling.description: Autoscaler configuration for this node pool.
autoscaling.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

max_node_count.description: Maximum number of nodes in the NodePool. Must be >= min_node_count.
max_node_count.rationale: This setting affects capacity, density, availability, or cost, but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, privileged permissions, data residency, or vulnerability posture.

min_node_count.description: Minimum number of nodes in the NodePool. Must be >= 1 and <= max_node_count.
min_node_count.rationale: Minimum node count affects baseline capacity and cost but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

cluster.rationale: This field identifies the parent cluster for the node pool. It controls placement but does not directly grant access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

config.description: The configuration of the node pool.
config.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

autoscaling_metrics_collection.description: Optional. Configuration related to CloudWatch metrics collection on the Auto Scaling group of the node pool. When unspecified, metrics collection is disabled.
autoscaling_metrics_collection.rationale: CloudWatch metrics collection supports observability of the auto scaling group but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

config_encryption.description: The ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt node pool configuration.
config_encryption.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

kms_key_arn.description: The ARN of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt node pool configuration.
kms_key_arn.rationale: The KMS key ARN controls which key protects node pool configuration and should be restricted to approved keys.

iam_instance_profile.description: The name of the AWS IAM role assigned to nodes in the pool.
iam_instance_profile.rationale: The IAM instance profile controls the permissions granted to node pool instances. Unapproved profiles may grant excessive or unauthorised permissions.

image_type.description: Optional. The OS image type to use on node pool instances.
image_type.rationale: This beta-only field is not assessed in the current policy scope. Node security posture is covered by supported policy-backed fields such as version, IAM instance profile, KMS keys, security groups, SSH key pair, subnet, and location.

instance_placement.description: Optional.Details of placement information for an instance.
instance_placement.rationale: Instance placement controls tenancy and physical placement but does not directly grant access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions in the current policy scope.

instance_type.description: Optional. The AWS instance type. When unspecified, it defaults to `m5.large`.
instance_type.rationale: The instance type affects capacity and cost but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

labels.description: Optional. The initial labels assigned to nodes of this node pool.
labels.rationale: Labels provide metadata for nodes and support workload scheduling but do not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

proxy_config.description: Proxy configuration for outbound HTTP(S) traffic.
proxy_config.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

secret_arn.description: The ARN of the AWS Secret Manager secret that contains the HTTP(S) proxy configuration.
secret_arn.rationale: The secret ARN references proxy configuration stored in AWS Secrets Manager and should be restricted to approved secrets.

secret_version.description: The version string of the AWS Secret Manager secret that contains the HTTP(S) proxy configuration.
secret_version.rationale: The secret version selects a version of an approved proxy secret but does not independently grant access or permissions.

root_volume.description: Optional. Template for the root volume provisioned for node pool nodes.
root_volume.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

iops.description: Optional. The number of I/O operations per second (IOPS) to provision for GP3 volume.
iops.rationale: IOPS affects performance and cost but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

kms_key_arn.description: Optional. The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Customer Managed Key (CMK) used to encrypt AWS EBS volumes.
kms_key_arn.rationale: The KMS key controls encryption for the node pool root EBS volume and should use an approved customer-managed key.

size_gib.description: Optional. The size of the volume, in GiBs.
size_gib.rationale: Volume size affects capacity and cost but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

throughput.description: Optional. The throughput to provision for the volume, in MiB/s.
throughput.rationale: Throughput affects performance and cost but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

volume_type.description: Optional. Type of the EBS volume. When unspecified, it defaults to GP2 volume.
volume_type.rationale: Volume type affects performance and cost but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

security_group_ids.description: Optional. The IDs of additional security groups to add to nodes in this pool.
security_group_ids.rationale: Security groups control network access to node pool instances and should be restricted to approved groups.

spot_config.description: Optional. When specified, the node pool will provision Spot instances from the set of spot_config.instance_types.
spot_config.rationale: Spot instance configuration affects availability and cost characteristics but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

ssh_config.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

ec2_key_pair.description: The name of the EC2 key pair used to login into cluster machines.
ec2_key_pair.rationale: The EC2 key pair controls SSH access to node pool machines and should be restricted to approved managed keys.

tags.description: Optional. Key/value metadata to assign to each underlying AWS resource.
tags.rationale: Tags support resource identification, ownership, and cost allocation but do not directly grant access or permissions.

taints.description: Optional. The initial taints assigned to nodes of this node pool.
taints.rationale: Taints affect workload scheduling but do not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

location.rationale: The Google Cloud location determines where node pool metadata is stored and should be restricted to approved Australia regions to meet data residency requirements.

max_pods_constraint.description: The constraint on the maximum number of pods that can be run simultaneously on a node in the node pool.
max_pods_constraint.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

max_pods_per_node.description: The maximum number of pods to schedule on a single node.
max_pods_per_node.rationale: This setting affects capacity, density, availability, or cost, but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, privileged permissions, data residency, or vulnerability posture.

name.rationale: The resource name identifies the node pool but does not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

subnet_id.description: The subnet where the node pool node run.
subnet_id.rationale: The subnet determines network placement for node pool nodes and should be restricted to approved private subnets to avoid exposing nodes on public networks.

version.description: The Kubernetes version to run on this node pool.
version.rationale: The Kubernetes version can affect exposure to known vulnerabilities and should be kept within approved supported versions.

annotations.description: Optional. Annotations on the node pool.
annotations.rationale: Annotations provide metadata for the node pool and do not directly control access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

kubelet_config.description: The kubelet configuration for the node pool.
kubelet_config.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

cpu_cfs_quota.description: Whether or not to enable CPU CFS quota. Defaults to true.
cpu_cfs_quota.rationale: CPU CFS quota affects scheduling fairness but does not directly grant access or permissions.

cpu_cfs_quota_period.description: Optional. The CPU CFS quota period to use for the node.
cpu_cfs_quota_period.rationale: CPU CFS quota period affects scheduling fairness but does not directly grant access or permissions.

cpu_manager_policy.description: The CpuManagerPolicy to use for the node.
cpu_manager_policy.rationale: CPU manager policy affects scheduling behaviour but does not directly grant access or permissions.

pod_pids_limit.description: Optional. The maximum number of PIDs in each pod running on the node.
pod_pids_limit.rationale: Pod PID limit affects process accounting but does not directly grant access or permissions.

management.description: The Management configuration for this node pool.
management.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

auto_repair.description: Optional. Whether or not the nodes will be automatically repaired.
auto_repair.rationale: Auto-repair affects node availability but does not directly grant access or permissions.

project.rationale: The project identifies where the resource is created. It affects placement and ownership but does not directly define access, encryption, network exposure, or privileged permissions.

update_settings.description: Optional. Update settings control the speed and disruption of the node pool update.
update_settings.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

surge_settings.rationale: This block groups related settings. Security impact is assessed on specific child attributes.

max_surge.description: Optional. The maximum number of nodes that can be created beyond the current size of the node pool during the update process.
max_surge.rationale: Max surge controls update speed but does not directly grant access or permissions.

max_unavailable.description: Optional. The maximum number of nodes that can be simultaneously unavailable during the update process.
max_unavailable.rationale: Max unavailable controls update disruption but does not directly grant access or permissions.
